domain_judgments.rationale: No pre-trial registration or pre-specified statistical analysis plan is referenced to confirm that reported outcomes and multiple time-point comparisons were selected without bias.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged to be of some concerns, driven by limited detail regarding the random sequence generation and envelope opacity, as well as the lack of a pre-registered statistical analysis protocol.

design_rationale: Infants were randomly assigned to one of three groups using a computer-generated randomization table.

domain_judgments.rationale: More than 35% of randomized participants (53/150) were excluded from the primary efficacy analysis due to death, post-randomization consent withdrawal, or off-protocol treatment, with differential attrition across arms that substantially threatens the validity of the findings.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: One hundred and fifty infants were randomized and allocated to three groups. domain_judgments.rationale: The outcome was based on clinical oxygen dependency, an assessment that relies partly on clinician judgment regarding weaning, and outcome assessors and clinical staff were not blinded.

domain_judgments.rationale: No protocol or trial pre-registration is referenced, and primary emphasis was placed on per-protocol pairwise and post-hoc subgroup comparisons after the overall 3-group test and ITT analysis were non-significant.

design_rationale: The study is described as a prospective multicenter randomized trial where neonates were randomized to either a 3-day course of dexamethasone or placebo within four strata based on birth weight and a/A ratio.
